steps.js: (async () => { await window.__gitgood.actions.addLocalRepository(__REPO_PATH__); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const before = window.__gitgood.store.get(); return JSON.stringify({ fileCountBefore: before.status.files.length }); })()

(async () => { const cur = window.__gitgood.store.get(); window.__gitgood.store.set({ changes: { ...cur.changes, summary: 'Test commit from smoke' } }); await window.__gitgood.actions.commit(); window.__gitgood.actions.setView('history'); await window.__gitgood.actions.loadHistory(true); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const after = window.__gitgood.store.get(); return JSON.stringify({ fileCountAfter: after.status.files.length, topCommitSummary: after.history.commits[0] && after.history.commits[0].summary, historyCount: after.history.commits.length }); })()
